verdict.rationale: Orrick's own pages show country-level practices in the UK, Germany and France, each describing local startup and venture work from seed to later rounds. It also has an India-focused team and a global equity compensation group of 70+ lawyers offering a 'single point of contact for all your needs worldwide' across jurisdictions, so a founder could expand without hiring a second firm. Missing for 10: an explicit office list or count of countries, clarity on whether India is a staffed office or only a coverage team, and independent or hands-on confirmation of cross-border service.
